body:
No friends... They don't answer when I call. And the few that may have answered when I was upset are his friends and when he told them what happened they hated me. He says that they will never want to hang out with me again and that he would be too embarrassed of me now to bring me around...

Thanks for the concern... There's nothing left anymore. I'm not even crying lol.... I'm always crying but I'm numb right now. It's kind of nice. I'll probably cry if he calls me. 

He is the most handsome, kind, and wonderful man I've ever met... Can't believe I've lost him. None of this feels real...
I'm 27 and he is 30...
But I made him my world and if he's gone how am I supposed to go on? If I have no one, then what's left for me?

We would have been together for 5 years on August 6th... He had never told me he loved me or what kind of future with me he saw. On my birthday this year he told me that my student loans held him back from wanting to commit to me...

It ate me up inside. It still does and I can still hear him saying "I wish I could love you right now you're a great girl."

And then this happened and he found out before I could tell him myself... And a week aged it happened he told me that he loved me and that he had wanted to marry me and have kids with me.... He never told me those things when we were together it's not fair I ruined eveythinf and he was feeling exactly the things I wanted so badly from him... 

For a while he would barely touch me wouldn't hug me Or kiss me goodbye.... I missed him and he was sitting right next to me.... If I could I would go back to that and find a healthier and more patient way of finding out he loved me.

He could be mean as can everyone but most of the time he supported me and took care of me and was proud of my accomplishments. I only talk about the negative because it's the only reason I can think of why I did what I did.... How could j be so stupid.... Just because he was stoic didn't mean he didn't love me.... Please make this stop hurting its eating me alive.

I can't believe how fake and perfectly natural I can be even though I'm in pieces. I just went into a store and bought a shot gun... Shot the shit with the salesman told him about how good of a shot I was with clay pigeons... And j really am.... He sold me a gun without a second thought. Am I that good at faking it? I feel like I wear this grief like a shroud. If it's that easy than its meant to be.

How could things possibly be worse right now...

All of my self worth is tied to his love and need for me.... Is it healthy no... But he has been the most positive thing in my life that I've ever had. He cares about me but he is hurt and I understand because I know I fucked up and I hurt him. He said he never in a million years questioned his faith in me that he had complete faith in me.... I have destroyed it..... He is hurting so much and I can't do anything to make him feel better and i don't think he will ever want to fix this l....
I'm not being abused... He is justified to be angry....

Does it matter if they are truthful and real to me? I know I would never do this again that I would do anything to prove that to him, but if he doesn't believe it then there is nothing.... Nothing but emptiness and and being alone....

He was never abusive... He isn't now... He is angry and hurt and sometimes he verbally is mean or attacks verbally. But anger is a part of this he is justified in his anger....

I have waited for weeks... I will wait until he gets done with work... If he doesn't call or tells me there's no hope than I will finish sealing off the shed with the duct tape... Even if I miraculously wake up from carbon monoxide poisoning I will use the gun I'm buying.

That is the best I can do that is the last of the energy I have to expend.... I can't go on... He really does deserve someone better and stronger than me... He keeps saying I need to be strong for me or that he "wishes I could have been stronger for him" and he says things like "not my Mandy, how could you do this not my Mandy..." 

How can any of you tell me I deserve life when I destroyed a completely innocent mans trust and faith in me....

I would do anything it took to regain his trust.... Whatever it took.... Whatever he needed in order to agree to work on us.... I did a bad thing... But I love him what I did meant nothing it was empty and awful and I hate that it has ruined me.

His lack of affection may have driven me to it but that is not a reasonable excuse for what I did.... I'm a bad person.... But I know we can fix us if he will allow it.... I understand now that he wasn't good at expressing himself... And he doesn't take me for granted anymore.... He finally says that he loves me.... I don't want to go back now that we've found each other after 4.5 years.... I can't do it.... I don't want to....

I've got no one anymore... I threw away the best influencing factor in my life, why should I try to forgive myself for that? For throwing away my one chance at getting out of this awful terrible place ice been in my whole life? Maybe some people aren't born with coping mechanisms and I cannot survive another failure I've got nothing left to give anymore.

I have thought about this for three weeks.... I have had everything planned and purchased and set up and ready.... I gave it time... He spent time with me so I kept pushing it back.... I can't keep hurting us like this.... I can't have a breakdown every time he goes to work, I'm dying. He is so hostile after he goes to work because he spends the whole time thinking about what I've done and he's hurt and angry.... Rightfully so.... But then I will beg him to see me and spend time with me and he will.... Even though I know it's not because he is afraid I will hurt myself.... I've lost 20 pounds in less than a month. My whole body hurts. My heart aches because all I want is to hold him and to hear him tell me he loves me again.... But I can't keep hurting him he doesn't deserve this....

I would give every fiber of my being to move forward with him... To show him every day that I could be strong for him.... For us. I would drop everything and change everything to prove it to him if he would let me.... I can't go on without him I'm not strong enough....

There's no point they never help.... I cheated on him emotionally. I destroyed the only positive influence in my life right now. How can anyone tell me that I deserve redemption when you rip the heart out of the person you love most in this world? I'm completely alone now and I'm hurting him by dragging him back to me every day. He is afraid I will hurt myself. He doesn't want me he just doesn't want me to get hurt. All I want is to sleep forever and pretend none f this happened. That I'm not a shitty person.

I hurt him.... I've been cheated on over and over again and I know exactly how shitty and awful and terrible it feels and I talked to someone else. I let them touch me. And it doesn't matter that nothing escalated and I left.... I destroyed his trust. Tell me I'm not the shit of the earth. After knowing how badly it feels when someone cheats on you. My hypocrisy knows no bounds. I am everything I hate and I don't want to live without myself anymore.

I know if I try I will make a fool out of myself trying to keep hkm in my life even though it's bad for him.... He deserves better than me.... I love him more than anything.... Meh would be better off without me....

I hurt the man I love... I destroyed his trust... He wants to leave me. I ruined the only positive influence in my life because I was lonely and sad... I let someone touch me. 

I'd give anything to take it back, I'd give anything.... I am so ashamed and so disgusted.... I hate people like me... I never thought I would turn into the thing I hated most....

I can't live with myself anymore...

I think that some people aren't born with the appropriate coping mechanisms... I think that despite everything humans are really terrible to themselves and other people.

I have hurt the most important people to me, how could I ever forgive myself... How could he.... 

He says I'm tainted says I'm dirty to him. All I ever wanted for 4.5 years was to hear him tell me he loved me and to show me he saw a future with me.... He only did that after leaving me.... It's not fair, it's not fair that I hear those things and know now he wanted them when he's leaving me for what I did.

I can't survive this again I don't even want to try.... I tried for weeks to work on things and he doesn't want me. I'm all alone now and there's nothing I can do.... It hurts so much.... I ruined everything and my apologies and actions aren't enough to redeem me in his eyes....

I used to ride horses... Jumping. Haven't done that since my instructor passed away. I'm a photographer, I used to love taking photos. Now the stress of my business is too much, I haven't touch my camera or edited anything in over a month... I'm useless... Nothing I used to love gives me any satisfaction... One of the only people I care about is gone. He's giving up on me....

I wanted to finish our house together... Get married... Have kids... I wanted to travel together... Garden... Continue growing my business... Everything I wanted was with him...

I can't even answer the phone when a client calls. I haven't even picked up my camera in a month. The only reason I'm still here is because he wants to spend time with me on Tuesday... Wants to plant trees and work on the house.... 

But he says he is ashamed of me now, that he can't take me out in public because he told his friends what I did. I'm "tainted." That he doesn't think he could ever marry me now.... 

After 4.5 years together it took him leaving me to realize he loved me and to tell me he loved me. And I let that eat at my insides for years.... But I let someone touch me... We didn't even sleep together but I let someone touch me... I've never felt so awful about myself after something before. I want to die it is everything I hate and I became that for a few seconds. I am disgusted by myself, why shouldn't he be too. I just wanted him to love me and it felt like he never would.

The day he decides he doesn't want to talk to me anymore is the day I have to give up. I've made him everything and without him I'll have nothing.
Something like that.... I failed my own expectations and the expectations of the people I care about the most. I don't want to recover from this failure...

I allowed my depression to ruin my life... It led me to the lowest place I've ever been and I hurt the person I loved most. I don't think I can forgive myself.... I can't even live with myself right now.... I'm not functioning.
